stories.title: CISO Conversations: Patti Degnan – Part of the Job Is Deciding What Not to Do
stories.description: Patti Degnan’s identity was stolen in 2006. It set her on a path to the CISO seat at endpoint security firm Glow.

stories.title: CISA Warns of Puppet Enterprise Vulnerability Actively Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has warned that attackers are exploiting a critical vulnerability in Perforce Puppet Enterprise.

stories.title: Chrome 158 Patches 204 Vulnerabilities
stories.description: Google handed out $11,000 for five externally reported flaws but has yet to determine the amounts to be paid for 36 bugs.

stories.title: Microsoft Agent Framework Releases Poisoned With Credential Stealer
stories.description: Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 of agent-framework on PyPI steal Azure, Azure DevOps, and GitHub Actions credentials when Python starts.

stories.title: Chrome 158 Fixes 204 Vulnerabilities, Including Critical Code Execution Flaws
stories.description: Google released Chrome 158 for Windows, macOS, and Linux fixing 204 security flaws, including six critical memory bugs.

stories.title: Critical Perforce Puppet RCE Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-115731, it allows a client that holds any CA-signed agent certificate to execute code on the server.

stories.title: Hackers Hijack Old Bitly Links in Burger King, McDonald’s and Trump Posts to Redirect Users
stories.description: Old Bitly links from Burger King, McDonald’s, and major X accounts now redirect users to unrelated and offensive content.

stories.title: Anthropic Reduces Vulnerability Disclosure Deadline from 90 to 30 Days as AI Quickly Identifies Flaws
stories.description: Anthropic is cutting vulnerability disclosure deadlines, saying AI-driven bug discovery makes the traditional 90-day fix window too long.

stories.title: Hackers Exploiting Critical Puppet RCE Flaw Affecting Enterprise Management Servers
stories.description: CISA flags active exploitation of CVE-2026-115731, a critical Puppet RCE flaw requiring a valid agent certificate.

stories.title: CISA Urges Immediate Patching of Java4Shell Flaw That Could Allow Remote Code Execution
stories.description: CISA urges patching CVE-2026-114938 in Oracle Java after tests showed malformed Base64 input could crash the JVM and corrupt application data.

stories.title: Attackers Compromise Microsoft's Agent Framework PyPI Package to Steal Cloud Credentials
stories.description: Two malicious Microsoft Agent Framework releases on PyPI used Python startup hooks to harvest cloud and CI/CD credentials; both were removed.

stories.title: Russian COLD RELIC Hackers Use Stolen Google Workspace Data to Breach Second U.S. Organization
stories.description: Cold Relic used stolen cloud data and employee impersonation to breach a second U.S. organization through Entra ID phishing.
